thesis.infer: Price and OI rise together while BTC funding falls below zero, so we read this as new longs adding against shorts that are paying to stay, not crowded carry; ETH and SOL funding is near the cap but still within normal range (z30 +0.65 and +0.88). Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read the risk as a hawkish tone given the 10Y above 5%. The disagreement: crypto OI is at a 30-day high while stablecoin supply is flat to lower and the Macro lens is Restrictive, so risk skews toward a fragile, positioning-led advance if the dollar firms.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close below $81.7K breaks it and is hl-cycles' stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.4K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil under $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and support a move toward the Mean MVRV price ($105.7K), far overhead.
